verdict.rationale: A virtual mailbox SaaS could plausibly offer recurring automation, such as scheduled forwarding or auto-scan rules, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only on-demand requests and a one-off 'schedule a day and time for pickup', which is a single scheduled action, not a recurring schedule. Probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec, so there is no documented programmatic or recurring workflow scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
